title: Finding Payload
description: One blocking (or non-blocking) finding submitted by REVIEW as part of review-result.schema.json. This is the payload shape a Reviewer submits, which is distinct from the persisted finding record in state.schema.json (ticket_id, status, first_detected_attempt, last_seen_attempt, reopen_count) that the Runner computes and maintains. The Runner matches submitted findings to persisted ones by (ticket_id, finding_key) to decide OPEN / RESOLVED / REOPENED per Harness main document section 8.

finding_key.description: Stable slug identifying the same underlying issue across Review attempts for one Ticket, e.g. 'missing-null-check-login'. The Reviewer must reuse the same key across attempts if the issue is unresolved or reopened, and use a new key for a genuinely different issue.

criterion_ref.description: The Acceptance Criterion this finding relates to.

blocking.description: Non-blocking findings are recorded but do not by themselves prevent a PASS verdict.
